attrs.text:
NEWBIE INFO

Welcome to Midgaard. You start in the Common Square, the middle of town,
where the beastly fidos roam: level 0 dogs, an easy first fight.

  look, score, equipment      where you are, how you stand, what you wear
  where fido                  which streets the fidos are in right now
  consider fido               how a fight with it would go
  kill fido                   fight it; a round every 3 seconds
  flee                        run, when a fight goes badly
  rest  ...  stand            sit down to heal faster, then get up
  get all from corpse         loot what it carried

Fidos come back to the Common Square, Poor Alley (west) and both ends of
Main Street (north, then west or east) a minute or two after they die.

Each kill earns experience; 1000 of it makes level 2 (and 2000 more, level
3). Every level brings hit points, a better THAC0, practices and a
training session (you start with five practices and three sessions).
Spend practices at your own guild's guildmaster with 'practice'
(warriors: north, east, east, south, east, south; mages: north, west,
west, south, south, east). Your guild's bar lets in only your class.

The cityguards are on your side: one passing by joins your fight against
an evil beast, and if his blow kills it, the experience is his. Fight
where no guard stands.

If you die you wake in the Common Square, a quarter of a level's
experience poorer; your corpse, with everything you carried, waits where
you fell ('get all from corpse').

The Mud School, up from the Temple of Mota (north, north, north, up), has
weak monsters to practise on, no guards, and a trainer ('train') for your
training sessions.
